forbiddenInferences: Do not call all unmapped identities untouched.
Do not infer Finance→Economics or Harness→Computing coverage while those owners are not current Atlas publications.
Do not infer Host novelty from weak external mapping.
Do not turn anchor status or region count into ontology centrality.
Do not aggregate frontier classes into a percentage of human knowledge.

identityFactStates.MAPPED_CURRENT_OWNER: At least one source-fenced current owner has an explicit DIRECT_PARTIAL_COVERAGE or BRIDGE_COVERAGE mapping to this ReferenceIdentity.
identityFactStates.NO_DIRECT_MAPPING_CURRENT_TEN_OWNER_PILO: No current mapping in the exact ten-owner crosswalk addresses this ReferenceIdentity. This is a pilot-state fact only and does not mean Ordivon never researched the area.

navigationPriorityOverlays.MAPPED_ANCHOR: Mapped identity that is also a current MajorRegion anchor.
navigationPriorityOverlays.MAPPED_CROSS_REGION_MEMBER: Mapped identity visible in two or more current MajorRegions.
navigationPriorityOverlays.MAPPED_SINGLE_REGION_MEMBER: Mapped identity visible in one current MajorRegion.
navigationPriorityOverlays.UNMAPPED_CROSS_REGION_MEMBER: Identity belongs to two or more current MajorRegion projections and has no current mapping. Cross-boundary navigation frontier.
navigationPriorityOverlays.UNMAPPED_MAJOR_REGION_ANCHOR: Identity is an anchor of at least one current MajorRegion and has no current mapping. High navigation-frontier value; not semantic importance or ontology centrality.
navigationPriorityOverlays.UNMAPPED_NO_REGION_MEMBER: Identity is normalized but currently belongs to no MajorRegion. This would be a topology-pressure signal, not automatically a coverage priority.
navigationPriorityOverlays.UNMAPPED_SINGLE_REGION_MEMBER: Identity belongs to exactly one current MajorRegion and has no current mapping.

ownerFrontierStates.CURRENT_EXTERNAL_MAPPING_WEAK: Current owner has mature research but no adequate direct external coordinate; adjacency does not count as coverage.
ownerFrontierStates.CURRENT_MAPPED: Current owner has at least one identity mapping.
ownerFrontierStates.CURRENT_OUT_OF_BOUNDED_REFERENCE_SCOPE: Current owner is valid/current but current bounded Reference World does not yet contain a directly relevant identity mapping.
ownerFrontierStates.NOVELTY_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Novelty is explicitly not admitted; may coexist with mapped or weak-mapping states.
ownerFrontierStates.PUBLICATION_UNAVAILABLE: Known Ordivon research owner/corpus is not a current Atlas owner source, so coverage absence must not be inferred.

priorityClasses.CURRENTLY_MAPPED: Identity has current source-fenced mapping; inspect scope/depth rather than treating as frontier absence.
priorityClasses.NAVIGATION_FRONTIER_A: Unmapped MajorRegion anchor. Highest structural navigation inspection class.
priorityClasses.NAVIGATION_FRONTIER_B: Unmapped cross-region identity. High cross-boundary inspection class.
priorityClasses.NAVIGATION_FRONTIER_C: Unmapped single-region identity. Ordinary bounded frontier class.
priorityClasses.TOPOLOGY_REOPEN_CANDIDATE: Normalized identity with no MajorRegion placement; invokes saturation reopen logic only if a high-value cluster emerges.
